_comment: Minimal Coupa OAuth scopes CIB needs for all master-data imports, invoice export and e-invoicing status sync. Generated from the hooks in this release by tools/generate_deploy_assets.py, so it cannot go stale relative to them. Coupa keys scope to the API's owning domain, not the object name (e.g. tax_codes -> common.read, tax_registrations -> invoice.read). Keys are the required scopes; values name the datasets each unlocks.

required_scopes.core.invoice.read: tax_registrations, invoice dup-check (export GET), e-invoicing status sync
required_scopes.core.invoice.write: invoice export (POST api/invoices), e-invoicing status sync
